content:
mat: Heads up — canary for new checkpoint (ckpt v3.7.1) shows p99 latency spike ~2x on staging-rt pools. Rolling pause. Anyone saw this?
ci-bot: CI perf monitor: staging-rt canary failed at 2419012330 — p95 +30%, p99 +120% vs baseline. Triggered by commit 8f3a2b4 (tokenizer mapping change).
anya: I pulled traces — KV cache eviction rate exploded, lots of tiny KV misses. Token boundaries look shifted, causing cache keys to miss more often.
ryan: Profiling: CPU time dominated by memcpy in batch scheduler while assembling prefixes. Kernel selector is falling back to fallback-attn for many requests because sequence segmentation changed.
sara: Quick inventory: two related merges in last deploy window — #4527 (tokenizer remap) and #4530 (batch/kernel heuristics). Could be interaction.
lee: Did a quick bisect across those commits. Reverts of #4527 locally -> p99 returns to baseline. Reverting #4530 didn't help. Strong correlation to tokenizer map.
mat: Solid. Short-term mitigation?
anya: We can pin the onboard config to use the older tokenizer mapping for this checkpoint and force kernel selector to prefer fast-attn for the canary. That should reduce KV churn.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by ops (mat) at 2419012400.
ryan: Proposed fix: normalize token->id mapping for legacy checkpoints so KV keys align with existing cached prefixes. I'll assemble a hotfix PR that preserves backwards-compatible mapping.
sara: Also recommend adding a runtime guard: if KV miss rate for a model jumps > 5% during onboarding, auto-fail the rollout and alert.
mat: Action items: ryan PR for normalization, anya prepare override config for canary, lee stand by to revert if needed, sara file CI/regression test ticket.
ryan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4612 — small normalization patch. Bench locally: p99 back to baseline, KV miss rate drastically reduced.
ci-bot: Perf run queued for PR 4612 (compare vs main) — estimate ~15m.
infra-bot: Note: reverting tokenizer mapping may affect new models depending on the updated tokenizer — validate downstream models before broad revert.
lee: Running staged canary with override (pin tokenizer v2 map + kernel override) on 5% traffic now.
deploy-bot: Canary resume requested by lee at 2419012550.
anya: Canary metrics look much better after overrides + hotfix: p99 stable, KV miss rate down from 12% -> 1.2%, tail latency normalized.
mat: Plan: merge hotfix, keep overrides for full rollout until next release, add CI regression to detect KV miss spikes during tokenizer changes, and document token map invariants.
sara: Filing the CI test ticket + postmortem doc. Will add to next sprint.
ryan: CI perf for PR 4612 passed: p99 within -1% of baseline. Merging now.
deploy-bot: PR 4612 merged and auto-deployed to staging canary at 2419012859.
mat: Marking resolved for the immediate incident. Postmortem follow-ups: (1) onboarding checklist update, (2) KV-miss regression test in CI, (3) token mapping compatibility checks for new checkpoints.
